Summer Island Challenge1. outlineThis is the area of ​​Escape from Duckov .Based on the second demo, there were only two playable areas in the game: the Zero Zone and the Warehouse Zone. After the official release, the Farm Village and J-Lab were added.2. prologueCharacter customization area. You can re-enter through the bunker's mirror.3. cageThis is where I was trapped.Tutorial area. Proceed to the left; if you go to the right, there is a hidden boss, the Prison Guard. Although it is a tutorial area, there is a very low chance that rare items such as graphics cards will drop. Related posts4. bunker4.1. basic facilitiesbedYou can pass the time by sleeping. Since sleeping does not deplete hunger or fluids, you can sleep without burden to get through the night or storm, or wait for the rain.storageThis is a place to store items collected from outside. Capacity can be expanded using money and resources. There is no need to approach and interact with the warehouse to open it; you can check it by simply opening the inventory from anywhere inside the bunker.vending machineThe only facility where merchants can trade before being unlocked. Sell ​​at a higher price than the market price and buy at a lower price. So, there are messages complaining that they are being ripped off from the items sold in vending machines. Of course, if you resell it, it costs 0 won.Construction panelA facility used to build another facility inside the bunker or modify the placement of the facilities.enhancerA facility where you can pay money and resources to strengthen the player's various abilities and change their characteristics. If the characteristics change, the game reloads.rangeA facility with targets with various armor levels where you can shoot firearms.Curist CircleThis is a place where unidentifiable letters and pictures are drawn. If you go down to the bunker's underground waterway, it is located on the left side of the map. When you defeat an enemy, you can obtain various totems by offering 8/80 of the 'Dark Feather' item that appears with a chance. The difference in functionality is whether it is 1 time or 10 times, so there is no such thing as a guaranteed 10 time item that is usually given in gacha games.4.2. construction facilitybenchProceed with item manufacturing/disassembly, repair, and blueprint registration.A workbench where you can craft various items. You can add production methods by researching recipes obtained from raids. Repair and disassembly are possible through upgrades, and there is a simple workbench in the external area that can only be fixed and disassembled. The simple workbench can only be repaired within the Summer Island Challenge.armor shopSells various helmets and armor.A facility required to house the armor merchant NPC 'Orange' in the bunker. Although it is less important than the weapon shop because armor is not difficult to obtain and it is usually more profitable to craft it by dismantling second-hand armor obtained during raids or grinding worn-out armor into fibers, there is a 'Tactical Knife Box'—a gacha item that drops high-tier melee weapons with a low probability while doing quests.[1] You end up spending a lot of money to sell it.weapon shopThese are weapons, ammunition, and items used for murder or plunder.Facilities required to move weapons merchant NPC ‘Mr. Kim’ into the bunker. Ammunition supply is limited, except for purchases, so you often end up in need of it. You can also purchase gunpowder barrels used to manufacture high-level ammunition and some low-level attachments. In particular, the cheapest way to manufacture armor-piercing ammo or higher is to collect normal or higher ammunition and combine it with gunpowder barrels and 'metal pieces'.[2] Since it is a reliable means, it is advantageous to collect it after the restocking time has passed even when going out or doing maintenance within the base.key registerOnce you register the key, you can freely open the door.A facility where you can register keys and card keys obtained in raids. Keys registered at the key register can always be used without having to take them to raids.[3] Consumable keys with durability and the ‘mine iris information’ that opens the farm village mining site cannot be registered.Transmission device (teleporter)You can start from more places.A facility that allows you to teleport directly to an area where a beacon is activated. Except for the zero zone where the bunker is located, it takes a considerable amount of time to move, so although it is an essential facility, the spawn location cannot be determined and is sent to a random location within the area. Travel fees are charged from the farm village, and J-Lab also requires a certificate.gymIt's a place to train your body and mind... Huh?Facilities required to allow NPC ‘Mud’ living in Zone Zero to move into the bunker. Here, you can strengthen the player character's body, and they also sell temporary strengthening items such as syringes and candy cans. Players who use a lot of syringes for bosses or dangerous battles will often be indebted to Mud.technology centerThere are only two computer desks.Facilities required to move NPC 'Jack' into the bunker. They sell small electrical/electronic components and items related to J-Lab, such as storms and space glocks, and you can also purchase certificates required to enter J-Lab. You can also enjoy mini-games by installing a controller and monitor on the game console that spawns in the farm village.kitchenBuddha's kitchen. You can replenish energy and moisture by cooking.Facilities required to move the NPC 'Buddha Brother' into the bunker.A facility where you can hydrate and satisfy your hunger. By researching survival skills, you can research the player's moisture and energy consumption rate reduction and fishing skills. As long as the gauge is not filled continuously, Manago Buddha himself only sells a few fishing supplies as a merchant, but he has the advantage of buying a slightly higher purchase price than other merchants as well as vending machines, so he comes by often.infirmarySome medical products can be made.A workbench where you can craft medicine. You can add production methods by researching medicine recipes. Even in the later stages, there are few recipes that can be opened, and the final healing item, a large first aid kit, cannot be made. Syringes are complicated, as the materials for making them are quite strange and require a significant increase in fishing skills, so it is more advantageous to rob a pharmacy in a farm village or buy them from a mud or dark merchant than to make them here. Even by the latest version standards, it is a very inadequate facility.ATMDeposit or withdraw cash.Cash withdrawal machine. In-game cash is a physical item, so unlike money deposited into an account, it cannot be spent in general stores. Cash is priced at half its face value when sold at a store, but when deposited at an ATM, it can be exchanged for gold at a 100% rate. Conversely, since gold can be withdrawn as cash without a fee, you can take it with you when shopping at black stores in the zero zone and farm villages. It can be built after exploring the warehouse area and unlocking the warehouse area beacon. There is an identical ATM in the farm village city hall, but there is a chance that a BA captain will spawn in the city hall, and the route is not very good, so it is rarely used.black market junctionAccess the black market network and conduct transactions with price fluctuations.Unlocked after constructing the ATM. You can buy or sell limited items through a randomly appearing supply and demand list. In general, vending machines and stores follow the market price, but there are cases where products are sold at a special price lower than the market price or purchased at a higher price than the market price. The item list can be rerolled for 6 hours without an upgrade, and once every 5 hours after the final upgrade. Reroll opportunities can be accumulated up to 5 times. The motif character is Ragman from Tarkov. To be exact, it is the flea market he runs. There is a low probability of selling high-end weapons such as the M107 or MCX Spear that have not yet been unlocked for purchase or production. There are cases where bundled buying/selling is done, and there are many cases where significant profits can be made when combining low/high prices. What users are mainly targeting are expensive items, such as pure gold badges or secret keys, which cost tens to hundreds of thousands of won. If it is popular to purchase multiple items at a high price, you can earn hundreds or tens of millions of won at once.Bitcoin mining machineMining, everyone knows.Unlocked after constructing the Black Market Junction. A facility where you can mine Bitcoin by increasing computing power by plugging in a graphics card or potato graphics card. If you don't plug in a graphics card, you can't mine Bitcoin. Potato graphics cards provide +0.1 computing power, regular graphics cards provide +1, and graphics card SLI provides +1.5 computing power. SLI blueprints can be obtained from J-LAB. There are 4 Bitcoin slots, and as warned not to place items, when a Bitcoin is created in that space, if there is an item in that space, it will be deleted(!). A graphics card is a fairly rare item, and even if all slots are filled with SLI, the efficiency of obtaining funds is very low. Even if you fill it up entirely with SLI, it is only a small amount of money, so it is a good idea to access it occasionally to make money even when you are not playing, or to process Bitcoin into coin strings and sell them in bundles on the black market at special prices or use them to make coin swords. To fill all the slots with graphics card SLI, you need 36 graphics cards, but 4 coins are worth about $32,712 based on chef sales, and one graphics card costs $11,146, so if you are in a hurry, it is much better to just sell the graphics card. Occasionally, if you fail continuously at the limit or higher, you can use it to pull out the graphics card plugged into the mining machine and sell it.Commemorative trophyClear celebration.Suddenly, there is an inscription commemorating the clearing, but it was originally a trophy commemorating the clearing of the demo version. This is an NPC decision that gives a quest, and if you clear all the quests, you can purchase a challenge boarding ticket from a vending machine to enter the demo Ultimate Challenge. If you clear all quests, it becomes a decoration with no function.3D printer3D printer with AI technology. Printing simple objects consumes a large amount of computing power.Among the blueprints, the blueprint in the shape of an SD card can be registered here. However, it is difficult to build quickly because five graphics cards are required as construction materials.showcaseFor displaying and displaying items.It can be built with 3 wooden planks and 3 nails. It is structured in steps and can display a total of 12 items, 4 on each floor. There are 60 compartments underneath, so it can also be used as a warehouse.gun display rackFor display of firearms collection.Can be constructed with 3 scrap metal pieces, 2 bolts, and 2 nuts. The same number of guns can be displayed as in the display case, and there are 60 storage compartments below.Dummy No. 1For equipment display.Excluding the bag and totem spaces, there are a total of 7 spaces: main weapon, secondary weapon, melee weapon, head, body, face, and headset. You can wear it in your usual settings and change into it, or you can equip it and display the loot you got from defeating the boss.Dummy No. 2For equipment display.Dummy No. 3For equipment display.green screenIt has no practical use.As explained, there is no suitable use. It's good to bring a character to a green screen and turn on photo mode for a while to take pictures.4.3. NPCJeffHe is the only NPC present when you first arrive at the bunker. He guides you through the facilities and gives you quests. According to his notes, he was a former member of J-Lab's research team. A gaming enthusiast, he used to sneak out during work hours to play games in the theater, putting him at risk of being fired. However, when the planet suddenly faced collapse, J-Lab attempted to build a spaceship to escape with him, but he refused and remained on this planet. Afterward, he found an abandoned bunker in the Zero Zone with the intention of forming a team, and he rescues the player, who was imprisoned, to recruit them as his first member. His motif is Prapor from Tarkov.mudA brown muscular duck who lives in a gym enthusiast's house with a basketball hoop in the zero zone. After completing a few quests and building a gym in the bunker, you will move to the bunker. Increases the player's abilities through physical strengthening. It gives you many quests related to melee weapons, and when you complete the quest line, you can purchase various doping items such as syringes and candy cans. Perhaps the motif is Tarkov's Therapist, but the image is quite the opposite. As if he enjoys the risk, he can be seen sitting on the extra seat that was roughly attached to the outside of the spaceship when installing additional seats in the ending. The challenge text is also first class for Mud.orangeAn NPC who runs the bunker's armor store. It sells equipment such as bulletproof vests, bulletproof hats, and bags. The SCIFI helmet, which can be purchased in the late game, is a penalty-free class 5 head armor that can be purchased on a fixed basis, so it acts as a savior when you are liquidated. Since it is mostly armor that is manufactured or obtained as loot, it is not very important, but there are many quests that require various bags to be submitted, and various melee weapons and karambits obtained from the 'tactical knife box' that can be purchased through quests in the latter half of the game are useful, so they are often used.Mr. KimThe original text is Xavier. An NPC who runs the bunker's weapon shop. Sells guns, ammunition, basic gun attachments, etc. In addition to selling low-quality attachments and ammunition on a regular basis, users who want to manufacture high-quality ammunition are constantly indebted to merchants in order to purchase gunpowder barrels. It gives various weapon quests, and there are some quests that are quite difficult, such as blowing off the head of a boss with a variety of weapons, so they are both loved and hated by users.jackNPC recruited when constructing a technology center. A person in charge of repairing spaceships for escape. According to the note, he was a former J-Lab employee like Jeff. It gives you a lot of quests related to storms or space attributes, but the difficulty is quite high in the early to mid-levels. Clearing quests is essential for various endings. The motif is Tarkov’s Mechanic.Buddha typeNPC recruited during kitchen construction. Buy items at a slightly higher price.[4] Survival enhancements reduce the player's energy and water consumption rates or increase fishing efficiency. Thanks to this purchase price advantage, many players place it in an easily accessible location in a bunker or near a workbench.blue manNPC in the basement of the warehouse area.Players can be strengthened through 'strange modification', which sells some rare items and consumes large quantities of blue cubes. Although it is located outside, unlike black merchants, payments can be made without cash. However, you must bring the items needed to unlock the passive skill yourself. Blue cubes can be obtained by killing enemies while equipped with the Cube Collector, a special bag sold by this merchant. However, the performance of the bag is not very good, and you have to kill a lot of enemies to unlock the final passive, which is quite annoying. In the story, the blue cube is a spirit, and seeing as it's a fairly extraordinary NPC as it's opening a store in a basement filled with poisonous gas.[5]black traderThere are NPCs located one on the mountaintop in the center of Zero Zone and another on the hill in front of the Farm Village nursing home. They sell various items at 10-minute restock intervals, and among them, the Farm Village Black Market sells important items such as Mark Keys (O/X), Night Vision Goggles, J-LAB Card Keys, and high-grade weapons of Legendary rarity or higher.[6] It also buys items from your inventory for cash at a price lower than the market rate. However, since transactions are only possible with cash, you must bring cash in your pet bag if you are visiting. Judging by its appearance and role, its motif is Fence from Tarkov.Unlike other interactable NPCs, these people do not have a health bar but can attack. However, since they operate in a lawless area, their health is extremely high and their defense is high, so it is not easy to engage in regular combat. The Zero Zone merchant is equipped with a homemade hunting rifle, and the Farm Village merchant is equipped with a Desert Eagle.[7] It is a stronger enemy than most bosses, but its AI is quite passive, so it needs to be hit like Lightman, the Zero Zone boss, to counterattack, and it doesn't move much from the spawn location, so it can be easily defeated by starting the attack by covering it with a cardboard box and throwing a lot of explosives, or shooting it one at a time from behind cover from a distance.[8] It's easy to catch. When killed, the weapon and ammunition used are[9] , gives rare items such as J-Lab key card and MAX bag as loot.5. zero zonezero zone零号区 | Ground Zero[ Entire Map - Expand / Collapse ][Map Information - Expand / Collapse]regionbunker entranceobstacleescape pointpeculiar281caveareabubblelocked doorBeacon4251NPCMud, dark merchantQuests and Collectiblesquest pointquest itemblueprintmemo412158compensationfield itemBoxmedical boxfood box153515tool boxammunition boxTactical/weapon boxclothes501697hideoutbox of love82enemy spawn pointIn generalboss63etctrash cans and otherbench21Full information: #This is the area where the bunker, the player's headquarters, is located. It consists of the southern area where the player bunker and Hellchang Ori NPC 'Mud' are located, the eastern area where the main road leading up and down and the road camp next to the road are located, the western area where you can access the bridge leading to the cave in the central mountain, and the northern mountain area where you can go to the warehouse area. If you have captured J-Lab's boss, Barricade, and obtained a level 3 certificate, you can move from the eastern area to the final area, the storm area. There is a dark merchant at the top of a low mountain.The map boss, Little Duck, is equipped with equipment of a fairly good level compared to the local level, so if he is frequently liquidated and loses most of his items, he may be deliberately sought out for farming. In addition, there is a safe where you can use the consumable item 'safe key' obtained in the area after the warehouse area, so you often go there to consume the safe key. In the northeastern corner of the mercenary camp where Little Deok is located, there is a shortcut that can be opened with the melee weapon 'crowbar', so you can go in through this path and only rob the safe and come out, or you can use the sandbags piled up in front of it to start the battle at an advantage. However, since it is a one-time short cut, the disadvantage is that a crowbar is required each time it is opened.Main farming spots include the camp with Little Duck and the cabinet on the mountain leading to the warehouse area. There are quite expensive items in the fence that can be opened with a level 3 certificate, but you can only enter by grabbing the barricade, so this is out of the question.[10] .The name is derived from Ground Zero in Tarkov , but the map itself resembles Woods more than Ground Zero, which is infamous as a newbie killer.6. warehouse areawarehouse area仓库区 | The Warehouse[ Entire Map - Expand / Collapse ][Map Information - Expand / Collapse]regionobstacleescape pointareapeculiar376underground secret passagelocked doorBeacon102NPCblue manQuests and Collectiblesquest pointquest itemblueprintmemo-31107compensationfield itemBoxmedical boxfood box?7189tool boxammunition boxTactical/weapon boxclothes24121112hideout8enemy spawn pointIn generalboss96etcbench2Full information: #This is a more difficult area than the Zero Zone. Before activating the beacon, it can only be accessed one-way via the zipline installed on the North Mountain of the Zero Zone. It is largely composed of the Western Factory Area, the Northern Sawmill, the Central Farmhouse, and the Eastern Crossroads Camp.In the Zero Zone, mercenaries that appear only at Little Duck Camp and sometimes one or two at a time begin to appear in groups of three or four from various places. The level of difficulty is significantly higher than in Zero Zone, as ragmen often carry rifles or decent shotguns such as the MP-155 rather than bows, pistols, or low-level submachine guns. Bosses include the rapid-fire gang that randomly spawns in factories, farmhouses, and houses south of the canyon, and Rodden and his dog that roam throughout the warehouse. Unlike Zero Zone, where the boss spawns in a virtually fixed location, the rapid leader spawns randomly, and Roden wanders throughout the warehouse even after spawning, so a certain level of searching ability and caution is required.In a special area, there is a secret underground passage connecting the southwestern house and the factory. There are no enemies, but poison gas is spread everywhere, so a gas mask is essential. Inside the fence near the factory in the underground passage, there is a secret vendor, Blue Man, who sells unique upgrades and rare items.There is a massive structure, similar to the Reserve from the original game. The factory area resembles the Factory, true to its name.7. farm villagefarm village农场镇 | Farm Town[ Entire Map - Expand / Collapse ][Map Information - Expand / Collapse]regionbunker entranceobstacleescape pointpeculiar1110officeareabubblelocked doorBeacon248282NPCblack traderQuests and Collectiblesquest pointquest itemblueprintmemo-291318compensationfield itemBoxmedical boxfood box?3131729tool boxammunition boxTactical/weapon boxclothes38264518hideoutkey166enemy spawn pointIn generalboss?19etctrash cans and otherbench71Full information: #This is a large village accessible from the warehouse area. It is incredibly spacious with buildings densely packed on all sides, offering a whole new world to newcomers who have only been running around in the narrow maps of the Zero Zone and warehouse. Due to its sheer size, there are two entry points from the base, two beacons, four pairs of warp bubbles, and as many as 13 bosses . If you come to the farm from the warehouse, you are guaranteed to spawn at the Sanga Farmhouse in the northeast. It is broadly composed of the Northern Factory Area to the north, the Radar Base to the northwest, the Central Commercial District and School, the Southern Warehouse to the south, the Stealth Mine to the southeast, and the Sanga Farmhouse to the northeast.Electricity is flowing underground in the northern construction site, a tank lorry is always on fire in the southern warehouse mercenary camp entrance, and poison gas is always spreading in the southeastern chemical factory entrance. To enter safely, you will need rubber overalls, a set of asbestos overalls, and a gas mask. It is possible to break through the mercenary camp while only taking ground damage by wearing a totem with fire resistance II or higher. In particular, there is a southern beacon inside the mercenary camp, so you must visit it at least once.As the map becomes larger, the number of enemies increases significantly. While the typical scenario up to the warehouse area was a single group of enemies versus the player, the farm area frequently features chaotic skirmishes involving mercenaries, ragpickers, spiders, bosses, and the player, and getting ambushed from behind by other enemies is also common. Since there are so many enemies, engaging in combat can drag on once you get caught, so it is advantageous to minimize your footsteps using items like the Ninja Totem to avoid being seen as much as possible. Particularly starting from the farm village, enemies using armor-piercing rounds become more common, and sometimes enemies armed with high-grade or special rounds appear. Additionally, enhanced versions of ragpickers start appearing, making even the regular mobs difficult to ignore, so it is advisable to arm yourself heavily.There is a certain probability that a boss named '???' will spawn at a random location. It is marked on the map by a red '?' circle, and the screen gradually turns red as it approaches. It has formidable health and extremely fast tracking and attack speeds, making it difficult to catch when it first engages; however, since it only tracks players within its range, it is best to avoid it entirely if you are not prepared to fight it. Conversely, it can wipe out other bosses or enemies with its powerful stats, and upon defeat, it is guaranteed to drop rare items such as the MF-Toxic Liquid Blueprint or a random J-Lab Access Card (Red). Although it can clear out other bosses, if it spawns at the same time as Vida—who is the strongest at sustained damage and has incredible tanking ability—Vida can easily defeat ???.As special locations, there are locked buildings marked with X and O on the map near the Northeast Temporary Construction Site and the Southern Mercenary Camp. Each can only be opened using its own dedicated Secret Key. Secret Keys are dropped with a very low probability by the Mercenary Camp boss, 'Shotgun,' or sold randomly by the Black Market merchant in Farm Village for around 150,000 to 250,000 (cash). They also appear extremely rarely as loot from ordinary clothes or chests. Secret Keys are consumable keys with a durability of 10, decreasing by 1 each time they are used to open a room. Upon entering, Room O contains several high-value rare items, such as uncraftable Tier 6 Body Armor, a T-7 Thermal Scope, a Graphics Card, a Pure Gold Badge, and a Crown (selling for 10 million) . Room X offers lower loot value than Room O, typically containing Tier 4-5 Body Armor, an MP5, a Desert Eagle, and a String of Money. Cabinets or safes are sometimes found alongside the Secret Keys, but their contents are unremarkable. Color card keys to open J-Lab's locked rooms are usually most commonly found here.The research lab at the bottom is widely considered to be boring and prone to mysterious deaths, making it effectively a map dedicated to quests; furthermore, since the Storm Zone is essentially an area for the ending, simply wandering around it is a hassle. Consequently, even after completing the game, this area often becomes the one you visit most frequently. It features a vast map size, numerous enemies, and diverse routes for hunting distinctive bosses. Additionally, thanks to the aforementioned Mark Room, it yields the highest actual profit as long as you have the key.7.1. mazeThe motif is, of course, the labyrinth of Tarkov. The official translation was translated as maze.It is a kind of small challenge map added as a collaboration with Tarkov. You must clear the quest in experimental area 37 to enter, and the entrance can be accessed by checking the sink in the bathroom of the farm village nursing home.To enter, you need an exclusive key that can be purchased after clearing a quest. Since the map itself is small, the loot range is not very large compared to the high price of the key. However, along with Tarkov collaboration items, rare high-value items such as melee weapons, gems, and computer parts drop, so if you are lucky, it is possible to recover more than double the price of the key.Enemies come out wearing AK-47 standard ammo and a 4-core armor set. In addition, like the labyrinth in the original, there are booby traps, and if you look closely, you can graphically see a wire connected to a grenade. It makes a sound when touched, and explodes after about 1 second. It can be dismantled with a gun or melee weapon. Alternatively, you can escape the explosion range by running forward and rolling as soon as the gun is fired.Tagilla, strengthened after the medication, appears here, and when killed, you can obtain a special helmet, Tagila's axe, and Minotaur's enhancer. If you catch Tagila, Killa will spawn. When proceeding with the final quest in Experimental Area 37, Alex temporarily appears as a boss.The map is so narrow that even if you run just a little bit or hear a gunshot, enemies will act like ghosts and come out from all directions. Booby traps do not react to enemies in the labyrinth except the player, so caution is required in melee situations. If you're unlucky, you might end up facing Tagila at the next corner as soon as you enter, so be prepared.8. J-Lab Research InstituteJ-Lab Research InstituteJ-Lab main entrance | J-Lab[1st floor map - expand / collapse][2nd floor map - expand / collapse][Map Information - Expand / Collapse]regionescape pointarealocked doorBeacon4981Quests and Collectiblesquest pointquest itemblueprintmemo-31118compensationfield itemBoxmedical boxfood box?8365tool boxammunition boxTactical/weapon boxclothes6969key9enemy spawn pointIn generalboss?3etctrash cans and other3Full information: #There are many secrets hidden.This is the latter part of the farm village, which can be accessed by going down to the basement from the office building. Because the entire map is an indoor area, it is not affected by storms, weather, or time of day. Unlike previous maps, there are no separate escape points, but when you zoom in on the map, there are three escape points on the first floor and one on the second floor where a green light appears.[11]A J-Lab level 1 certificate (consumable) is required and consists of two layers. The lights on the second floor will not turn on unless you turn the power on in the power control room on the first floor, and the large room in the northwest of the first floor can only be accessed by turning the power on in the room opened with a J-Lab Level 2 certificate on the north side of the second floor. Therefore, in order to farm properly, going to the power control room on both sides is virtually essential, so you need to plan your movements well. To defeat the boss, Barricade, a J-Lab Level 2 certificate is required, which can be found randomly inside the lab.The right side of the south prison on the second floor can only be safely entered if you wear rubber work clothes. The northern room, which can be opened with a J-Lab Level 2 certificate, requires an eye patch or night vision goggles because transparent test subjects approach at high speed and attack in close quarters. If you're in a hurry, you can use an installed item like a capture trap to lure them out and then stun them, but it's only good for one or two uses.Scattered throughout the research facility are about five locked rooms marked with specific colors on the map, which can only be opened with dedicated colored key cards. While the key card itself can be used permanently once registered, just like a regular key, the probability of obtaining it from regular loot is extremely low. Although it can rarely drop from defeating the Black Market merchant in Farm Village or the boss, the Mine Master, the best method is to open the rooms marked with O or X in the aforementioned Farm Village. Since there is a lack of loot on the second floor, it is advisable to find and open the key cards for proper farming; specific blueprints are permanently present inside, and Space Protection Suit parts essential for farming the Storm Zone also spawn there.Considering that the Storm Zone is essentially a story progression area with many restrictions, it could effectively be called the final zone; however, J-Lab is widely regarded as the most boring zone in all of Duck Corp. Unlike the previous Farm Zone, which featured numerous bosses and diverse environments that made every run unique, J-Lab has only one fixed boss, the 'Barricade,' on the first floor. As a boss purely for main quest progression that drops no particularly useful items, it lacks the tension of suddenly encountering a boss and engaging in combat while farming, or the fun of running a boss run like Little Duck, who acts as a gear shuttle. Furthermore, since it is indoors, there is no day/night distinction, it is unaffected by storms, and the escape location is fixed, so there are no variables to add excitement when running through it multiple times. If one were to call it a variable, it would be getting killed mysteriously by a surprise attack from a Wanderer armed with special armor-piercing rounds or special ammo that can penetrate even Tier 6 armor; however, this feels more like an unfair attack than a variable, making it debatable whether it constitutes a fun element. The only enemies that appear are Wanderers or mechanical spiders.In terms of farming, it is not bad as you can easily find expensive, high-value items typical of a late-game zone, and enemies drop valuable ammunition like scrap or special steel rounds, as well as good items. However, the problem is that farming becomes frustrating due to the three main farming items in the J-Lab area that are required to clear quests or unlock skills. These are the Crystal Filtration Unit, Crystal Pressure Unit, and Accelerator , which are infamous as the "hopeless trio " of the late game and drop only from the J-Lab Box, a container exclusive to the J-Lab area . There is no guarantee that they will drop, yet they are required in all sorts of places—including high-tier passives, weapons, and armor—making the requirements ridiculously high. Furthermore, if you are unlucky, you often end up with only one of these items appearing in clusters, making it more of a stressful element dependent on luck than a fun farming experience. On top of that, these three items are heavy despite being junk, and since they cannot be stacked, each one takes up an entire inventory slot. Consequently, there are many instances where you are forced to reluctantly discard other items you have already picked up just to take them with you.The farming route is also highly wasteful; to farm the entire map, you must go through the absurd structure of ① turning on the lights on the second floor from the first-floor power control room, ② finding the randomly spawning Level 2 Certificates within the map, ③ going up to the second floor to open doors and turn on the lights while killing enemies that are invisible and effectively force you to use a thermal scope/eye patch, and ④ returning to the first floor to defeat the boss. This causes significant fatigue and stress. Furthermore, since there are as many as six rooms locked by the aforementioned card keys, the farming value on the second floor drops significantly unless you farm the keys in advance by grinding marked rooms, as there are too few meaningful rooms. Additionally, since storm creature attacks are spatial properties, it is good to have spatial resistance and burst immunity. Then, place high-grade armor in your pet container and, as soon as you enter the zone, run to the nearby boss bunker to eliminate the boss. Since there is no storm inside the bunker, you can use standard armor. Defeating any boss within the Storm Zone guarantees a drop of their respective exclusive weapon, armor set, and backpack. Both the armor set and backpack come with +1 Space Storm Defense, allowing you to remove the Storm Work Suit, which has abysmal defense. The backpack, in particular, provides a fixed +1 Space Storm Defense without any separate durability, so obtaining it gives you a lot of breathing room in your gear setup. As it is a quarter-view game, the gunplay is simple, but it also has the advantage of being more accessible. In addition to the fact that it is a single-player game, many say that light users who feel the burden of a full-fledged multiplayer competitive gun shooting game, as well as fans who suffered from the poor matching and rampant hacks of the original Tarkov, can enjoy it. Also, the fact that you can go back and retrieve your body even if you die is getting a good response.[10] It is easy to access and highly addictive due to its cute characters, easy-to-understand system, and quarter view.The downside is that the fun of growing your character while farming only extends to the farm village, and after that, higher-level items do not appear and there are almost no quests, making the game somewhat boring. In addition, the bosses in the storm area have high physical resistance and must be dealt with with attribute weapons, so it is unfortunate that no matter how much you fully set up the existing ending weapon, you end up using attribute weapons in the end.Patch 1.1.6, which was carried out on November 6, 25, received great reviews from users. There are content that adequately scratches the itch, such as adding stacks to items that take up a single stack for no reason compared to their size and increasing the amount of bullet stacks, but the biggest compliment is the weapon balance. Before that, only settings focused on reducing hip fire spread.[11] The development team, who recognized what was being played, made various improvements to give the weapon group and combat method that were neglected, such as mitigating the penalty of the high-magnification scope and increasing the range to give it an advantage in aimed shooting, as well as giving a penetration effect to the sniper rifle that has no reason to be used in the current Duckcorp, to give it room for use in the weapon group and combat method. Even though it is PVE, unlike other games that have balance patches that are difficult to understand, the patch is highly evaluated for being user-friendly.Separately, there is controversy regarding the translation exclusive to the Korean market. While there were some minor mistranslations due to it being a Chinese game, the quality of the initial translation was generally decent. However, at some point, it seems the translator changed, as patches resulted in a lack of consistency—sometimes transliterating words while others were fully explained. Furthermore, most system messages were changed to inappropriate honorifics, and the translation became incomprehensible and riddled with mistranslations, altering correct meanings into strange forms. To name a few examples, the bizarre mix of transliteration and Korean was used, changing "Tactical Knife" to "Bayonet Knife"; the absurd mistranslation of "Predecessor of the MF" in the MMG description to "Front Part of the MF"; "Purchase Required" in the Black Market and "Dog Tag" to "Name Tag"; and the "Quack Quack Looting" message that appeared when leaving a bunker—which was well-received for its cuteness—was abruptly changed to the nonsensical "Farming Time."[12] It tends to be disliked by many users.9. showAs the game continues to spread through word of mouth, the number of concurrent users continues to increase, showing a steady upward trend. Furthermore, shooting recklessly would immediately expose one's location, leading to severe criticism and accusations of unfair treatment. Since Tarkov is a PvPvE-based multiplayer game while DuckCorp is a purely single-player game featuring only PvE, they do not cannibalize each other's market share; instead, they are effectively serving as indirect promotion for Tarkov. Additional collectibles11. etc1. outlineThis document concerns mods for Escape from Duckov . On Steam , mods can be accessed via the Steam Workshop . Unlike Tarkov, mod support is active, so it is easy for the game to become heavily modded.2. Precautions when using the modeBecause there is a possibility that some mods contain malicious code, manufacturers recommend using only popular and verified mods if possible. Related NoticeIn fact, there was an incident where the GitHub account of the modder who developed the cooperative mode was hacked and malicious code was planted in the cooperative mode. Related Post 1 There was also a case where an impersonation mod with malicious code was uploaded by illegally copying the live minimap mode , another mode of the modder who developed the cooperative mode . Related Post 2 Related Post 3In addition, there was an incident where malicious code was later planted in the mod through an update due to a modder's change of mind, and after related post 4, the production company banned three modders involved, and other mods involved in the modder were removed from the Steam Workshop. Developer Notice Steam Discussion (summary of events, Chinese) Steam Discussion (summary of events, English) Related Posts Related Posts (List of Sanctioned Mods)How to deal with malware3. systemIt is a mode that serves as the basis for other modes.HarmonyLibThis is a base mod required to run many mods. If you subscribe to a mod that requires HarmonyLib, a message will appear prompting you to subscribe to this as well. You need to change the order in the in-game Mods menu so that HarmonyLib is at the top.ModSettingThis is a base mod that creates a settings window for mods. Once installed, you can easily change the settings of various mods. A tab called "Mod Settings" is added to the ESC settings menu.ModConfigThis is a mod that creates a settings window similar to ModSetting. For some mods, you must install ModConfig instead of ModSetting to get the settings window.自定义热键(CustomHotkey)Mode related to changing shortcut keys. If the mode supports changing shortcut keys, that mode is required.Duckov Custom ModelMods related to modeling changes. If the mode changes modeling, the corresponding mode is required.快速模组开发库鸭科夫自定义音效/Duckov Custom Sounds4. languageKorean Translation PatchA mode that corrects awkward translations and mistranslations in Korean (Hangul).Duckov Mods - Korean Translation PackSupports Korean translation of some modes. See link for list of supported modes.5. Convenience (no difficulty effect)Item Value Rarity Display & Search SoundsMod that adds an indication of item rarity (based on sales price), readjusts search times, and adds search sounds. In fact, it is one of the modes that is so responsive that it is treated as Duckcorp's basic system.[1] It is a mode that is useful without significantly harming the essence of the game, so even players who play as pure as possible can use it without difficulty.Show The CostA mode that displays the store selling price of an item.[2]Fancy Items & SoundsA mod that adds an indication of item rarity (based on drop rate) and a search sound. When you press F7, the settings window appears.Fancy Items & Sounds with ModSetting SupportA mod that adds item rarity (based on drop rates) and search sounds. This is an improved version of the aforementioned mod; to prevent key conflicts between mods, the mod has been reconfigured based on ModSetting and the settings window has been moved to the in-game settings screen instead of the F7 key.Fancy Items RarityA mod that displays rarity and selling price when hovering over an item. It can be used in combination with one of the three rarity display modes mentioned above.EfD EnhancedA mode that maximizes game convenience with various functions. Quest tracking, improved mobility, weapon comparison, warning before heading out,[3] Other convenience settings are provided. A mode that allows you to use items registered on the shortcut bar with the ~ key through the wheel action menu, and allows you to use the throwing equipment you own with the G key through the wheel action menu even if it is not registered on the shortcut bar.Highlight Available PluginsWhen you select a weapon, the attachments and bullets that can be equipped are highlighted.Bullet EjectorWhen an enemy dies, the bullet automatically detaches from the gun. This is useful when killing enemies with expensive bullets, like Lab, and collecting only the bullets.Show inventory CountA mode that displays the total inventory quantity in the current backpack and warehouse in the item description.显示任务需求道具 - Show quest item requirementsA mode that shows the quantity needed for future quests or upgrades in the item description.按重量/价值/价重比排序（Sort by weight/value/ratio）A mod that adds sorting options for item price, weight, and price+weight to the inventory screen and warehouse. PistolThese are the basic firearms that can be seen from the tutorial, and in reality, there are mainly three types: TT-33, PM, and Glock. It uses S bullets in the same way as a submachine gun, but it has a small magazine capacity, cannot fire continuously, has a short range, and has a low peak due to the small number of parts that can be attached, so it is usually used only in the early stages.However, unlike most other weapons, there is no penalty to the movement speed coefficient, it is very fast to load, and it has the advantage of being light enough to not exceed 1kg. In addition, its value is low, so it is cheap to purchase and produce, and although it does not fire repeatedly, single-shot damage is high. As the game itself has fast movement speed and the advantage of run-and-gun, it is an advantage that cannot be ignored. When using heavy and slow-loading guns such as sniper rifles or RPKs, or weapons with extreme bullet consumption such as MMG, it is suitable as an auxiliary weapon to kill mobs at close to mid-range by using it with higher-ranking bullets. In this case, I tend to use the Glock or Space Glock, which has the best performance among handguns.When you lose a lot of items and go out to recover, you can take them with you and use them to grab nearby enemies and arm yourself with enemy items. Some quests also require you to kill bosses or enemies with a pistol. This quest can be very stressful if you don't normally use a pistol.[2]With the Myeongjo collaboration update, the situation has finally improved with the addition of two new weapons.3.1. Magnification scopes significantly increase aiming distance, allowing you to spot enemies at long range; however, they are rarely used because they are inconvenient, as they severely increase recoil and narrow the field of view. Most importantly, they only extend aiming distance; even with an 8x scope, the actual range increases by only 10%. Due to the nature of the Duckscope, where damage is reduced by 50% if the target is more than halfway away, it is impossible to inflict proper damage. Consequently, when using magnification scopes, players typically limit themselves to 2x or 4x. Even then, since non-magnification scopes increase the critical hit multiplier, it is common to attach a non-magnification scope to the primary weapon and a magnification scope to the secondary weapon.All non-magnification scopes have the same performance except for the Red Dot, which is the lightest in weight.
